title: Publish current Android Vulkan driver evidence
requires: Physical Android device with the production Vulkan driver and adb access
scope: Rebuild the current Android Slang Vulkan driver, execute applicable public-API reference, physical-quality and adverse-lifecycle contracts on physical hardware, and publish revisioned evidence independently of Gallery performance and lifecycle sweeps.
acceptance: The result pins clean source, exact APK and driver hashes, public device model and GPU, Android and Vulkan driver versions, NDK/compiler and Slang toolchain plus immutable contract hashes.

Every advertised Vulkan capability records all applicable execution, reference, analytic-quality and adverse-lifecycle outcomes; failures, unsupported modes, validation limitations and missing contracts remain explicit.
Register and regenerate the per-driver evidence index from a fresh checkout; retain native validation, Gallery, thermal and timing reports only as clearly separated supplemental evidence.
